name: Linux 登入與 SSH
summary: Linux SSH、sudo 登入看板與登入失敗告警
description:
Linux SSH、sudo 登入看板與登入失敗告警
收集方式：Syslog UDP。這個套件不會建立 Input，請自行建立並把來源指向它。
★ 安裝後必做：到 Streams 啟動串流。Graylog 建立的串流都是暫停狀態，啟動前管線和看板都沒有資料。
告警預設不掛通知，事件只會寫進 Graylog；需要通知請自行加上。

description.@value: Linux 登入與 SSH 的記錄（比對訊息內容，不看主機名）

source.@value:
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-result-user-sourceip-protocol"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "from ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: ": %{DATA:syslog_result} for %{USERNAME:syslog_user} from %{IPV4:sourceip} port .* %{WORD:syslog_protocol}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sudo-auth-failed"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "sudo:auth")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "\\(sudo:auth\\): %{DATA:syslog_result}; logname=%{USERNAME:syslog_logname} uid=%{WORD:syslog_uid} .* ruser=%{USERNAME:syslog_ruser} rhost=%{GREEDYDATA:syslog_rhost} user=%{USERNAME:syslog_user}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sudo-session-opened"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "pam_unix(sudo:session)")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: " session opened for user %{USERNAME:syslog_sudo_to_user}\\(uid=%{WORD:syslog_sudo_to_uid}\\) by %{USERNAME:syslog_user}\\(uid=%{WORD:syslog_uid}\\)", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-pam-auth-failed"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "pam_unix")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "auth\\): %{DATA:syslog_result}; .*user=%{USERNAME:syslog_user}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-pam-session-opened"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "pam_unix")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "session opened for user %{USERNAME:syslog_user}\\(uid=%{WORD:syslog_uid}\\)", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-application"
when
    has_field("message")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "pam_unix\\(%{GREEDYDATA:application}\\)", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sourceip"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "authentication failure")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "%{IPV4:sourceip}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-user"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "user=")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "user=%{DATA:user} ", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-application-2"
when
    has_field("message")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: " %{DATA:application}\\[", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-accept-pwd-user"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Accepted password for ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Accepted password for %{USERNAME:user} ", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-accept-pwd-sourceip"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Accepted password for ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Accepted password for .* %{IPV4:sourceip} port", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-failed-pwd-user"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Failed password for ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Failed password for %{USERNAME:user} ", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-failed-pwd-sourceip"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Failed password for ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Failed password for .* %{IPV4:sourceip} port", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "linux-login-10-syslog-user2"
when
    has_field("full_message") && contains(to_string($message.full_message), "user=")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: " user=%{WORD:user}", value: to_string($message.full_message), only_named_captures: true));
end

pipeline "Linux 登入與 SSH - parse"
stage -1 match either
rule "linux-login-00-gate"
stage 0 match either
rule "linux-login-00-passthrough"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-result-user-sourceip-protocol"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sudo-auth-failed"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sudo-session-opened"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-pam-auth-failed"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-pam-session-opened"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-application"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-sourceip"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-user"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-application-2"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-accept-pwd-user"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-accept-pwd-sourceip"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-failed-pwd-user"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-failed-pwd-sourceip"
rule "linux-login-10-syslog-user2"
end
